messages:
violet: New POC — large regulated customer wants an on‑prem, fully air‑gapped pilot. Key asks: encrypted media delivery (prefer SSD), offline activation, signed provenance/SBOM, monthly security-only patches and a clear upgrade cadence. Need a short tech+commercial sketch for the bid. @samir can you lead presales?

samir: On it. Quick clarifiers: 1) single-file max they accept on a cartridge? 2) acceptance of multipart images and resumeable installs? 3) signing preference (customer key vs vendor HSM vs escrow)?

kevin: They replied: cartridge cap ~300GB, prefer single‑cartridge but will accept multipart. Must have auditable chain‑of‑custody. Prefer customer keypair but can consider vendor HSM if we document escrow options and lead times.

nina: Ops notes: Recommend NVMe for >120GB; for any artifact >40GB we convert to multipart parts <=20GB and include a resumeable installer. We ship a small offline verifier that checks signed manifest + SBOM before install.

nina: Example manifest we include in the bundle (for integrity verification):

```
manifest_version: "1"
artifacts:
  - name: model-v3-int8.bin
    parts: ["p000","p001","p002"]
    sha256: 3a7bd3...
    signed_by: redwood-release
provenance: provenance-v3.signed.tar.gz
```

samir: Security constraints: must be able to rotate certs without internet, permit telemetry off-by-default, and provide reproducible build logs for any vendor-produced quantized models. If we manage keys in HSM with escrow, procurement lead time ~6 weeks.

kevin: Activation flow proposals: (A) CSR -> we sign offline activation token -> customer imports; (B) signed license file bound to hardware fingerprint. Both fully offline. We'll include step‑by‑step playbook.

violet: Buyer wanted monthly security deltas but only quarterly feature drops. Can we commit?

nina: Yes: security-only monthly delta bundles + quarterly feature bundles. Note: delta creation for quantized artifacts typically requires a rebuild/validation run; expect 24–72h prep depending on model size. We'll list these windows in the SOW.

legal: Questionnaire flagged export controls for quantized weights and chain‑of‑custody liability. We should include a clause that final pricing is contingent on BOM and model export classification.

samir: Ballpark for offline packaging + signing + provenance work: $28k–$65k depending on number of artifacts, HSM/escrow complexity, and on‑site validation days. Final quote post‑BOM.

kevin: Acceptance checklist to include in SOW: 
- delivered media verifies against offline CA signatures
- SBOM + signed provenance tarball provided
- installer completes without external DNS/NTP and fails safe on checksum/signature mismatch
- chunked install resumes on interruption and verifies checksums
- cert rotation tested in staging with no internet
- rollback to previous signed bundle validated within SLA window

ops-bot: Note: staging offline rig maintenance window scheduled 2026-04-09 02:00-05:00 UTC — good for chunked-install + cert-rotation tests.

violet: Action items: 1) I will request BOM, max artifact sizes, and whether GPUs will be provided (ETA: EOD). 2) @samir to confirm ML acceptance of quantized fidelity and delta timelines. 3) @nina to run chunked-install + verifier smoke on staging and post logs. 4) @legal to draft export/escrow clause and contingent pricing language.

samir: Ack. I'll draft the tech annex and include three signing options and the price band.

violet: I'll reply to buyer with the recommended NVMe + signed multipart approach, the acceptance checklist, and the preliminary price band. Keeping this thread as tracker. Thanks all.
